Verteron.note: image px = offset + scale * world coordinate (x -> right, y -> down), no flip or rotation; the composite is 2048 px wide for the 8x8 tiles, multiply by 8 for the native 16384 px map
Verteron.fit: 95.6 % of 5272 pet-monster spawn points on land; checked with three places of a recording: Insel der Ewigkeit, Zumionstaett, the purple forest west of Suedlicher Tolbaswald (accuracy about 100 m)

Altgard.note: image px = offset + scale * world coordinate (x right, y down, no flip or rotation); fitted on the 1024 px overview of Karte_Altgard.png, the 8192 px map is 8x that
Altgard.fit: least squares on four places of a recording matched with the map screenshots (Klarwald, Absturzstelle x2, Namenloser Friedhof); residual up to 6 px on the 1024 overview = about 50 m; 79 % of the pet-monster spawn points on land. The scale differs 5 % from Verteron's, so the error grows towards the far edges.

Abyss.note: image px = offset + scale * world coordinate (x right, y down, no flip or rotation); fitted on the 1024 px overview of Karte_Abyss.png (the 4096 map is 4x that)
Abyss.fit: 97 % of the 990 pet-monster spawn points of Reshanta_A on land; three places of a recording (SW island 17:56, north island 17:58, NW island 18:04) with their map screenshots all on the right island. Only checked by eye on the islands, not by an independent arrow match: accuracy not measured (expect a few hundred metres).
